text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family:'WenQuanYi Micro Hei','Microsoft YaHei','SimHei',sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #20303f

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family:'WenQuanYi Micro Hei','Microsoft YaHei','SimHei',sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #20303f

g.text: 并联电阻支路（共十一条，R0 无继电器）

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family:'WenQuanYi Micro Hei','Microsoft YaHei','SimHei',sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #20303f

g.text: 串联电感线圈（共十一节）

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family:'WenQuanYi Micro Hei','Microsoft YaHei','SimHei',sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #20303f

g.text: 主回路导线与汇流母线

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family:'WenQuanYi Micro Hei','Microsoft YaHei','SimHei',sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #b03a2e

g.text: 关键逻辑：电阻继电器闭合＝工作；电感继电器断开＝工作，两者相反。

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family:'WenQuanYi Micro Hei','Microsoft YaHei','SimHei',sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #d35400
font-size: 10.5px; font-family:'WenQuanYi Micro Hei','Microsoft YaHei','SimHei',sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0e7490
font-size: 10.5px; font-family:'WenQuanYi Micro Hei','Microsoft YaHei','SimHei',sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #20303f

g.text: 图中触点仅为符号，实际通断由继电器状态决定。

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family:'WenQuanYi Micro Hei','Microsoft YaHei','SimHei',sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f3a5f

g.text: 拓扑连接说明（看文字即可还原接法）

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family:'WenQuanYi Micro Hei','Microsoft YaHei','SimHei',sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #d35400

g.text: ① 十一条电阻支路并排接在左、中两条汇流母线之间，彼此并联；R0 直接接入，R1～R10 各串一只继电器后接入。

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family:'WenQuanYi Micro Hei','Microsoft YaHei','SimHei',sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #7b3fa1

g.text: ② 电阻继电器闭合＝该支路接入，断开＝该支路退出；固定电阻 R0 不受继电器控制，始终在回路中。

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family:'WenQuanYi Micro Hei','Microsoft YaHei','SimHei',sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0e7490

g.text: ③ 十一节电感 L1～L11 自上而下首尾相连成串联链，每节两端并接一只短接继电器；断开＝电感投入，闭合＝该节被短接退出。

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family:'WenQuanYi Micro Hei','Microsoft YaHei','SimHei',sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f3a5f

g.text: ④ 电阻并联网络的中汇流点与电感链首端相连，电感链尾端接输出端；因此本组＝（R0 与 R1～R10 并联）串联（L1～L11 串联链）。
